means: A danbooru tag asserting the image contains exactly one character - no second figure, no half-person at the edge of frame.
does: Suppresses spare limbs, second faces and the stray bodies SDXL likes to grow at the frame edge. It is the cheapest anti-clutter insurance on this model. What it does NOT do is empty the background: 'night stadium, crowd' plus solo still gives you packed stands, because a crowd is scenery rather than a character. The inverse is grammar too - when you want one character, solo in the positive plus 'multiple boys, multiple views' in the negative is stronger than either half alone.
reach_for_it: on every single-character shot, immediately after the count tag - it costs one tag slot and prevents the ugliest failure mode
used_in: the second tag of all three character cards (RASK, VIRO, MANAGER) and of every character beat in derby-ep1; 'multiple views' already sits in the project's standing negative for the same reason
example_base: 1boy, solo, male focus, short black hair, dark jacket, standing on a rooftop, city skyline behind, late afternoon sun, looking away, masterpiece, best quality, very aesthetic, absurdres
read_it_as: Compare the SHADING, colour and line - not the pose or framing. Adding any clause re-rolls the model's conditioning, so composition moves between the two panels even at a fixed seed. An img2img pass from one fixed base image would isolate the tag properly; that is not built yet.
